title: Silver Bow Mining to acquire metallurgical complex in Montana, US
summary: The agreement includes two mineral processing circuits, infrastructure and the Montana Tunnels M-Pit in Jefferson County.

summary: Silver Bow Mining (NYSEAMERICAN:SBMT) said it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire the Jefferson County Metallurgical Complex in Montana, a past-producing processing site located about 55 miles by road from the company’s Rainbow Block project in Butte. title: Silver Bow Mining Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire the Jefferson County Metallurgical Complex in Montana
summary: BUTTE, Mont., August 24, 2026--Silver Bow Mining signs agreement to acquire the Jefferson County Metallurgical Complex to support evaluation of its Rainbow Block Project.

title: Silver Bow Mining Re-Establishes Underground Access at Its High-Grade Rainbow Block Silver-Zinc Project
summary: BUTTE, Mont., August 19, 2026--Silver Bow Mining re-establishes underground access at Rainbow Block, marking Butte's first underground exploration in decades.

title: Silver Bow Mining Appoints Montana Mining Executive Doug Stiles as President
summary: BUTTE, Mont., July 27, 2026--Silver Bow Mining Corp. appoints Doug Stiles as President, further strengthening its executive leadership with deep Montana mining experience.

title: Silver Bow Mining Added to Russell 3000, MicroCap Indexes
summary: BUTTE, Mont., June 24, 2026--Silver Bow Mining Corp. (NYSE American: SBMT) ("Silver Bow Mining" or the "Company"), a minerals exploration company advancing the Butte Mining District of Montana, targeting a broad suite of U.S.-designated Critical Minerals, announced today that the Company has been selected for inclusion on the Russell 3000 and Russell MicroCap Indexes, [effective June 26, 2026].

title: Silver Bow Mining Reports Initial Assay Results From Drill Program
summary: BUTTE, Mont., June 22, 2026--Silver Bow Mining reports drill results from Rainbow Block confirming Critical Mineral enrichment and vein extensions beyond resource estimate.

title: Silver Bow Mining Receives Authorization to Proceed from Montana DEQ for Expanded Rainbow Block Exploration Program
summary: Authorization enables Silver Bow Mining to advance underground development, bulk sampling, and expanded surface drilling at its flagship Critical Minerals project in the Butte Mining DistrictCEO: Rainbow Block holds "...the potential to provide a long-term supply from one of the largest and highest-grade underground silver-zinc deposits in the country, including the extraction and recovery of up to 11 U.S.-designated Critical Minerals"Butte, Montana--(Newsfile Corp. - May 26, 2026) - Silver Bow.
